description: Opened La Jornada confirms march and justice demands but no attendance or end time. SSC/El Universal search snippets report 8,000, based on city estimate; direct SSC body was tool-inaccessible and El Universal live page failed as restricted URL. Neither exact URL will be retried; threshold pending.
Separate public actions occurred 30 Oct and 18–19 Dec. No evidence of uninterrupted mobilization between them; keep distinct and ask review whether linked campaign.
Spanish web searches covered general, CDMX and Ecatepec leads; no systematic state-by-state press archive census or Lexis-Nexis. Not exhaustive.
